name: kotlin-android-skills
description: A compact set of Kotlin and Android development skills centered on MVI Activities, AdSpace integration, and analytics

plugins.name: mvi-activity
plugins.description: Lean MVI pattern for Android Activities with Jetpack Compose. Use when building Compose-first Activity screens with UiState, Action, Event, StateFlow, SharedFlow, and a small ViewModel boundary.

plugins.name: traceless-analytics-sdk
plugins.description: Traceless Analytics SDK for Android - Firebase-first analytics SDK for tracking screen views and UI interactions.

plugins.name: adspace-integration
plugins.description: AdSpaceSDK (AdMob Next-Gen wrapper) integration for Android. Covers Banner, Native, Interstitial, Rewarded, Rewarded Interstitial, Open App, CMP consent, Firebase Remote Config, and resume ads.
